58653-the-revealing-pattern.title: The Revealing Pattern
58653-the-revealing-pattern.creator: Unknown
58653-the-revealing-pattern.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Nothing to do with the supernatural at all. My work is to prove that all occurrences, however mysterious, are the logical result of previous actions of individuals; that superstitions are the result, not so much of ignorance, but lack of knowledge."

arxiv-1908-08297.title: IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2019 EGNet: Edge Guidance Network for Salient Object Detection
arxiv-1908-08297.creator: Jia-Xing Zhao, Jiang-Jiang Liu, Deng-Ping Fan, Yang Cao, Ju-Feng Yang, Ming-Ming Cheng
arxiv-1908-08297.description: Abstract Fully convolutional neural networks (FCNs) have shown their advantages in the salient object detection task. However, most existing FCNs-based methods still suffer from coarse object boundaries. In this paper, to solve this problem, we focus on the complementarity between salient edge information and salient object information.

arxiv-1911-01072.title: Wearable Affective Life-Log System for Understanding Emotion Dynamics in Daily Life
arxiv-1911-01072.creator: Byung Hyung Kim and Sungho Jo
arxiv-1911-01072.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Byung Hyung Kim and Sungho Jo. Past research on recognizing human affect has made use of a variety of physiological sensors in many ways. Nonetheless, how affective dynamics are influenced in the context of human daily life has not yet been explored. In this work, we present a wearable affective life-log system (ALIS), that is robust as well as easy to use in daily life to detect emotional changes and determine their cause-and-effect relationship on users’ lives.

arxiv-2101-04367.title: Sensitivity-Conditioning: Beyond Singular Perturbation for Control Design on Multiple Time Scales
arxiv-2101-04367.creator: Miguel Picallo, Saverio Bolognani, Florian Dörfler
arxiv-2101-04367.description: Abstract A classical approach to design controllers for interconnected systems is to assume that the different subsystems operate at different time scales, then design simpler controllers within each time scale, and finally certify stability of the interconnected system via singular perturbation analysis.

arxiv-2106-04694.title: Exponentially-Weighted Energy Dispersion Index for the Nonlinear Interference Analysis of Finite-Blocklength Shaping Corresponding author: K. Wu (email: k.wu@tue.nl).
arxiv-2106-04694.creator: Kaiquan Wu, Gabriele Liga, Yunus Can Gültekin , and Alex Alvarado
arxiv-2106-04694.description: Abstract A metric called exponentially-weighted energy dispersion index (EEDI) is proposed to explain the blocklength-dependent effective signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in probabilistically shaped fiber-optic systems. EEDI is better than energy dispersion index (EDI) at capturing the dependency of the effective SNR on the blocklength for long-distance transmission.

arxiv-2211-03201.title: Quality over Quantity: Optimizing pulsar timing array analysis for stochastic and continuous gravitational wave signals 2022 Quality over Quantity: Optimizing pulsar timing array analysis for stochastic and continuous gravitational wave signals – 16
arxiv-2211-03201.creator: Lorenzo Speri, Nataliya K. Porayko, Mikel Falxa, Siyuan Chen, Jonathan R. Gair, Alberto Sesana, Stephen R. Taylor
arxiv-2211-03201.description: Abstract The search for gravitational waves using Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) is a computationally expensive complex analysis that involves source-specific noise studies. As more pulsars are added to the arrays, this stage of PTA analysis will become increasingly challenging. Therefore, optimizing the number of included pulsars is crucial to reduce the computational burden of data analysis.

arxiv-2211-07986.title: Perturbed nuclear matter studied within Density Functional Theory with a finite number of particles
arxiv-2211-07986.creator: F. Marino, G. Colò, X. Roca-Maza, E. Vigezzi
arxiv-2211-07986.description: Abstract Nuclear matter is studied within the Density Functional Theory (DFT) framework. Our method employs a finite number of nucleons in a box subject to periodic boundary conditions, in order to simulate infinite matter and study its response to an external static potential.

arxiv-2212-02205.title: Simulations of Collisional Effects in an Inner-Shell Solid-Density Mg X-Ray Laser
arxiv-2212-02205.creator: Shenyuan Ren, Sam Vinko, Justin S. Wark
arxiv-2212-02205.description: Abstract Inner-shell K α \alpha x-ray lasers have been created by pumping gaseous, solid, and liquid targets with the intense x-ray output of free-electron-lasers (FELs). For gaseous targets lasing relies on the creation of K-shell core-holes on a time-scale short compared with filling via Auger decay.

arxiv-2304-05518.title: Understanding Creep in Vitrimers: Insights from Molecular Dynamics Simulations
arxiv-2304-05518.creator: Gurmeet Singh, Veera Sundararaghavan, Vikas Varshney
arxiv-2304-05518.description: Abstract Vitrimers offer a promising sustainable alternative to conventional epoxies due to their recyclability. Vitrimers are covalent adaptive networks where some bonds can break and reform above the vitrimer transition temperature. While this can lead to desirable behavior such as malleability, this also leads to undesirable rheological behavior such as low-temperature creep.

arxiv-2309-08444.title: Neural Network Exemplar Parallelization with Go
arxiv-2309-08444.creator: Georg Wiesinger, Erich Schikuta
arxiv-2309-08444.description: Abstract This paper presents a case for exemplar parallelism of neural networks using Go as parallelization framework. Further it is shown that also limited multi-core hardware systems are feasible for these parallelization tasks, as notebooks and single board computer systems. The main question was how much speedup can be generated when using concurrent Go goroutines specifically.

arxiv-2409-18222.title: Trustworthy AI: Securing Sensitive Data in Large Language Models
arxiv-2409-18222.creator: Georgios Feretzakis, Vassilios S. Verykios
arxiv-2409-18222.description: Abstract Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing (NLP) by enabling robust text generation and understanding. However, their deployment in sensitive domains like healthcare, finance, and legal services raises critical concerns about privacy and data security. This paper proposes a comprehensive framework for embedding trust mechanisms into LLMs to dynamically control the disclosure of sensitive information.

arxiv-2501-11075.title: The thermodynamic stability and phase structure of the Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg-AdS black holes
arxiv-2501-11075.creator: Yinan Zhao, Hongbo Cheng
arxiv-2501-11075.description: Abstract In both canonical ensemble and grand canonical ensemble, the thermodynamic stability and phase structure of Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg-AdS black hole are studied. We derive the Hawking temperature, Helmholtz free energy, Gibbs potential, entropy and heat capacity of the black holes. We compute the minimum temperature to find that the phase transition may happen at the lowest point.

arxiv-2504-00663.title: Sim-is-More: Randomizing HW-NAS with Synthetic Devices
arxiv-2504-00663.creator: Francesco Capuano, Gabriele Tiboni, Niccolò Cavagnero, Giuseppe Averta
arxiv-2504-00663.description: Abstract Existing hardware-aware NAS (HW-NAS) methods typically assume access to precise information circa the target device, either via analytical approximations of the post-compilation latency model, or through learned latency predictors. Such approximate approaches risk introducing estimation errors that may prove detrimental in risk-sensitive applications.

arxiv-2510-10027.title: p p -retract Rationality and Norm One Tori
arxiv-2510-10027.creator: Kazuki Sato
arxiv-2510-10027.description: Abstract . We study whether the norm one torus associated with a finite separable non-Galois field extension K / k K/k is p p -retract rational over k k for a prime p p , focusing on the case where the Galois group of the Galois closure of K / k K/k is either the symmetric or the alternating group.

arxiv-2511-19502.title: Some Generalizations of Totient Function with Elementary Symmetric Sums Thanks: Dedicated to Bhagawan Sri Sathya Sai Baba.
arxiv-2511-19502.creator: Udvas Acharjee, N. Uday Kiran
arxiv-2511-19502.description: Abstract We generalize certain totient functions using elementary symmetric polynomials and derive explicit product forms for the totient functions involving the second elementary symmetric sum. This work follows from the work of Tóth [The Ramanujan Journal, 2022] where the totient function was generalized using the first and the k t ​ h k^{th} elementary symmetric polyomial.

britannica-1911-sion-college.title: Sion College (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-sion-college.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-sion-college.description: Article 'Sion College' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a college, gild of parochial clergy and almshouse, under the will (1623) of Dr Thomas White, vicar of St Dunstan’s in the West. The clergy who benefit by the foundation are the incumbents of the City parishes, of parishes which adjoined the city bounds when the college was founded, and of parishes subsequently formed out of these.

pmc-10747833.title: Automated Service Height Fault Detection Using Computer Vision and Machine Learning for Badminton Matches
pmc-10747833.creator: Guo Liang Goh, Guo Dong Goh, Jing Wen Pan, Phillis Soek Po Teng, Pui Wah Kong
pmc-10747833.description: In badminton, accurate service height detection is critical for ensuring fairness. We developed an automated service fault detection system that employed computer vision and machine learning, specifically utilizing the YOLOv5 object detection model. Comprising two cameras and a workstation, our system identifies elements, such as shuttlecocks, rackets, players, and players’ shoes.

pmc-11716122.title: Racial differences in neuropathology and cognitive abilities
pmc-11716122.creator: Claudia Kimie Suemoto, Renata Elaine Paraizo Leite, Vitor Ribeiro Paes, Roberta Diehl Rodriguez, Alberto Fernando Oliveira Justo, Michel Satya Naslavsky, Mayana Zatz, Carlos Augusto Pasqualucci, Ricardo Nitrini, Eduardo Ferriolli, Wilson Jacob‐Filho, Lea T Grinberg
pmc-11716122.description: BackgroundRacial differences in dementia prevalence and incidence were found with higher dementia burden in African descendants. Previous neuropathological studies were conducted mostly in white participants in convenience samples. Further studies in diverse populations are important to foster the understanding of race differences in dementia pathology.

pmc-11860113.title: Analysis of drug-drug interactions in spontaneous adverse drug reaction reports from EudraVigilance focusing on psychiatric drugs and somatic medication
pmc-11860113.creator: D Dubrall, R Weber, M Boehme, M Schmid, B Sachs, C Scholl
pmc-11860113.description: IntroductionPatients with severe mental illnesses (SMI) are often exposed to polymedication. Additionally, the risk of somatic diseases is twice as high in patients with SMI as in individuals without a psychiatric disorder. Furthermore, drug–drug interactions (DDI) between psychiatric drugs and somatic medications are a well-known cause of adverse drug reactions (ADR).

pmc-12669829.title: Hybrid inverse treatment planning optimization in gynecologic brachytherapy: Comparison with conventional method
pmc-12669829.creator: Hiroyuki Okamoto, Masato Nishitani, Ayaka Nagao, Naoya Murakami, Noriyuki Okonogi, Jun Takatsu, Kotaro Ijima, Satoshi Nakamura, Takahito Chiba, Hiroki Nakayama, Tetsu Nakaichi, Takumi Sakamoto, Kae Okuma, Hiroshi Igaki, Daisuke Ozaki, Ken Ando, Tatsuya Ohno
pmc-12669829.description: PurposeTo investigate a semi-automatic hybrid inverse treatment planning optimization (HIPO) approach for gynecological brachytherapy that preserves the pear-shaped dose distribution without relying on dummy structures.Material and methodsWe retrospectively analyzed 29 patients with gynecological cancers, who underwent combined intracavitary and interstitial (IC/IS) brachytherapy. HIPO enables optimization of dwell times for specific applicators, while other applicators are fixed in Oncentra® Brachy.

pmc-12969635.title: Revealing the influence of top-brewing and bottom-brewing methods on the flavor of green tea based on the interaction between EGCG and aroma compounds
pmc-12969635.creator: Mengke Zheng, Zhongyi Mao, Yinan Yang, Guihong Qi, Peng Li, Yufeng Luo, Donghao Zhang, Jianping Xie, Shihao Sun
pmc-12969635.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The brewing process is a crucial step in determining the flavor profile of green tea infusions. However, the flavor differences arising from top-brewing and bottom-brewing methods remain poorly understood, and the underlying mechanisms are largely unexplored. In this study, GC-MS and sensory analysis were employed to investigate the flavor differences in Shucheng Little Cymbidium tea infusions under varying water temperatures and brewing methods.

pmc-13077432.title: Single-sterilization modified-position robotic-assisted McKeown esophagectomy versus minimally invasive approach after neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy for locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-13077432.creator: Hailiang Cai, Guoqing Liao, Weijie Zhan, Yuhang Zhang, Lintong Yao, Liyu Cai, Weihuan Lin, Shaowei Wu, Jens-C. Rueckert, Luyu Huang, Haiyu Zhou
pmc-13077432.description: BackgroundSurgical resection remains a key component of multimodal therapy for patients with resectable or locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) after neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy (nCIT). This study compared the safety and efficacy of single-sterilization modified-position robotic-assisted esophagectomy (SM-RAE) with conventional minimally invasive esophagectomy (MIE), focusing on perioperative outcomes, composite adverse events, electronic patient-reported outcomes (ePROs), and short-term oncologic results.

pmc-13457092.title: A systematic review of the measurement of the renin-angiotensin and kallikrein-kinin system peptides in normotension and hypertension
pmc-13457092.creator: Elliot J. Gyedu, Sian Jenkins, Dan Lane, Ammar Akram, Farah Salim, Leong L. Ng, Donald J.L. Jones, Dennis Bernieh, Pankaj Gupta
pmc-13457092.description: Hypertension is the leading modifiable risk factor for cardiovascular diseases and affects over 1.3 billion adults. The renin-angiotensin and kallikrein-kinin systems (RAS and KKS) are critical in regulating blood pressure (BP). Clinically, the RAS and KKS have gained renewed importance, especially due to the discovery of the non-canonical vasodilative RAS pathway.

pmc-13621730.title: Complex postpartum fever caused by ovarian vein thrombophlebitis combined with acute pyelonephritis: a rare case report
pmc-13621730.creator: Wenzeng Chen, Qiuying Lin, Qiuhui Hong, Qingmin Wang, Li Jiang, Weiqun Ao
pmc-13621730.description: BackgroundOvarian vein thrombophlebitis (OVT) is a rare but serious postpartum complication. This report presents a case of OVT with acute pyelonephritis successfully managed at our hospital. By summarizing the clinical course, diagnostic process, and treatment—alongside a literature review—it aims to improve clinical recognition and management of this uncommon condition.

pmc-13719213.title: IgA Vasculitis Developing during Trastuzumab Emtansine Therapy for HER2-positive Breast Cancer
pmc-13719213.creator: Nanami Watanabe, Shun Yoshida, Keiichi Osano, Kie Ohkoshi, Toshihisa Ishii, Makiko Konishi, Haruka Nakada, Naoki Ashizawa, Yuko Nakayama, Hiroshi Mitsui, Kazuya Takahashi, Ayumu Nakashima
pmc-13719213.description: An elderly woman undergoing trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1) treatment for HER2-positive breast cancer visited our department with purpura, hematuria, proteinuria, and a decreased renal function. A skin biopsy revealed leukocytoclastic vasculitis with immunoglobulin A (IgA) deposition, confirming the diagnosis of IgA vasculitis. Owing to active renal lesions, the patient was treated with prednisolone and cyclophosphamide, which resulted in clinical remission.

shaw-man-and-superman-1903.description: Tanner flees marriage across Europe — with the famous Hell interlude.
